scoreboard.py.src:
print("Type 4 players as: name, score")
rows = []
for i in range(4):
    line = input("> ")
    name, score = line.split(",")
    name = name.strip().title()
    score = score.strip()
    if score.isdigit():
        rows.append((name, int(score)))
    else:
        print("  skipped " + name + ": the score must be digits")
total = 0
for name, score in rows:
    total = total + score
print()
print(f"{' SCOREBOARD ':=^34}")
print(f"{'PLAYER':<18}{'SCORE':>8}{'SHARE':>8}")
print("-" * 34)
for name, score in rows:
    print(f"{name:<18}{score:>8,}{score / total:>8.1%}")
print("-" * 34)
print(f"{'TOTAL':<18}{total:>8,}")
